internal.title: High Latency in Ad Service Due to Resource Exhaustion - Incident Resolved
internal.body:
At 10:49 UTC, an alert was triggered for high latency in the ad service. Diagnosis identified resource exhaustion in the ad service as the primary cause, with supporting latency issues in the recommendation and product-catalog services. CPU utilization in the ad service reached 98%, causing p95 latency to spike to 1.8 seconds.

At 11:08 UTC, the flag controlling CPU resource limits for the ad service was disabled, which immediately reduced CPU usage and latency. Recovery was verified shortly after, with latency metrics returning to normal levels.

The incident is now resolved. Further analysis and lessons learned are documented in the postmortem section.

external.body: Between 10:49 and 11:09 UTC, customers experienced increased latency in the ad service, which may have impacted ad delivery performance. The issue was caused by resource exhaustion in the ad service and was resolved by adjusting resource controls. Normal service performance has been restored.
